headings: Kayayyakin da aka samar masu alaƙa
records.text: Monorepo ko multirepo Abubuwan da ke ciki: Taƙaitawa Matsala Shawara Matsayi Cikakkun bayanai Zato Ƙuntatawa Ra’ayoyi Hujja Tasiri Mai alaƙa Shawarwari masu alaƙa Buƙatu masu alaƙa Kayayyakin da aka samar masu alaƙa Ƙa’idoji masu alaƙa Bayanan kula Taƙaitawa Matsala Aikinmu ya ƙunshi haɓaka manyan rukunoni uku na manhaja: GUI na gaba Ayyukan tsakiya Sabobi na baya Lokacin da muke haɓakawa, tsarin sarrafa nau’i (VCS) na sarrafa lambar tushe (SCM) ɗinmu shi ne git. Muna buƙatar zaɓar yadda muke amfani da git don tsara lambarmu. Zaɓin matakin sama shi ne a tsara a matsayin “monorepo” ko “polyrepo” ko “gauraye”: Monorepo yana nufin muna sa dukkan guntuwa a cikin babban repo ɗaya Polyrepo yana nufin muna sa kowane guntu a cikin nasa repo Gauraye yana nufin wani haɗin monorepo da polyrepo Don ƙarin bayani da fatan ku duba https://github.com/joelparkerhenderson/monorepo-vs-polyrepo Shawara Monorepo lokacin da ƙungiya/tawaga/aiki ƙanana ne, kuma saurin maimaitawa ya fi muhimmanci fiye da kiyaye dorewa. Polyrepo lokacin da ƙungiya/tawaga/aiki manya ne, kuma kiyaye dorewa ya fi muhimmanci fiye da saurin maimaitawa. Matsayi An yanke shawara. A buɗe don sake dubawa idan/lokacin da sababbin kayan aiki suka samu don sarrafa monorepos da/ko polyrepos. Cikakkun bayanai Zato Duk lambar da muke haɓakawa don kayayyakin ƙungiya ɗaya ne, ba don jama’a ba. Wato Broker-Dealer ba shi da niyyar samun wani abu kamar masu haɓaka sa kai na jama’a. Ƙuntatawa An rubuta ƙuntatawa da kyau a https://github.com/joelparkerhenderson/monorepo-vs-polyrepo Ra’ayoyi Mun yi la’akari da monorepos irin na Google, Facebook, da sauransu. Muna ganin duk matsalolin faɗaɗa monorepo suna da nisa a nan gaba har za mu iya amfani da ayyuka iri ɗaya da Google da Facebook, a lokacin da muke buƙatar su. Mun yi la’akari da polyrepos irin na ayyukan buɗaɗɗen tushe na Git na yau da kullum, kamar Google Android, Facebook React, da sauransu. Muna ganin waɗannan su ne mafi kyawun zaɓi don shigar jama’a (misali kowa a duniya zai iya yin aiki a kan lambar) da samuwar kowane ɗaya (misali ana amfani da aikin shi kaɗai, ba tare da wasu guntuwa ba). Hujja Lokacin da ƙungiya/tawaga/aiki ƙanana ne, muna zaɓar monorepo, domin saurin maimaitawa ya fi fifiko sosai fiye da kiyaye dorewa Lokacin da ƙungiya/tawaga/aiki manya ne, muna zaɓar polyrepo, domin kiyaye dorewa ya fi fifiko sosai fiye da saurin maimaitawa. Tasiri Idan akwai bututun CI+CD da ke akwai, to za mu iya buƙatar daidaita shi don gwada ayyuka da yawa a cikin repo ɗaya. CI+CD zai iya ɗaukar ƙarin lokaci don cikakken gini na monorepo, domin CI+CD zai iya gina dukkan ayyukan da ke cikin monorepo. Idan ƙungiya/tawaga/aiki ya girma, to monorepo zai fuskanci matsalolin faɗaɗawa. Matsalolin faɗaɗa monorepo na iya sa sauyawa zuwa polyrepo ya ƙara zama mai daraja. Sauyawa daga monorepo zuwa polyrepo babban aikin devops ne, kuma zai buƙaci a tsara shi, a sarrafa shi, kuma a shirya shi. Mai alaƙa Shawarwari masu alaƙa Za mu ƙirƙiri shawarwari don kayan aikin sarrafa monorepos masu alaƙa (misali Google Bazel) da polyrepos (misali Lyft Refactorator). Buƙatu masu alaƙa Muna buƙatar haɓaka bututun CI+CD ya yi aiki da kyau da git. Kayayyakin da aka samar masu alaƙa Muna sa ran tsarin repo ya kasance yana da kayayyakin da aka samar masu alaƙa don samarwa, sarrafa saiti, gwaji, da makamantan fannonin devops. Ƙa’idoji masu alaƙa Mai sauƙin sakewa. Idan monorepo bai yi aiki a aikace ba, ko shugabanci ba ya son shi, abu ne mai sauƙi a sauya zuwa polyrepo. Damuwa da Abokin Ciniki. Muna daraja sa aikin a hannun abokan ciniki, kuma mun yi imanin cewa monorepo na iya kai mu can da sauri fiye da polyrepo, kuma ya taimaka mana mu maimaita da sauri. Yi tunani babba. Google da Facebook masu goyon bayan monorepos ne sosai fiye da polyrepos, domin duk manyan kayayyaki za a iya haɓaka/gwada/ɗora su tare. Bayanan kula Ƙara duk wani bayanin kula a nan.

records.title: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: rumbun bayanai na MySQL
headings: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: rumbun bayanai na MySQL
records.text: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: rumbun bayanai na MySQL Take: Zaɓar MySQL a matsayin Tsarin Sarrafa Rumbun Bayanai don Aikin X Mahalli da Bayanin Matsala Muna buƙatar yanke wane tsarin sarrafa rumbun bayanai (DBMS) za mu yi amfani da shi don Aikin X. Za a yi amfani da rumbun bayanai wajen adanawa da sarrafa manyan adadin bayanai daga tushe da yawa. Muna buƙatar DBMS wanda zai iya sarrafa mu’amaloli, ya ba da iya faɗaɗuwa, kuma ya ba da babban aminci da tsaro. Cikin zaɓuɓɓuka daban-daban da ake da su, muna la’akari da MySQL a matsayin zaɓi mai yiwuwa. La’akari da Shawara Sauƙin amfani da kulawa Tallafin al’umma da albarkatu Aiki da iya faɗaɗuwa Tsaro da aminci Kuɗi da lasisi Dacewa da tarin fasaharmu Zaɓuɓɓukan da Aka Yi La’akari MySQL PostgreSQL Oracle Microsoft SQL Server MongoDB Sakamakon Shawara Bayan kimanta zaɓuɓɓukan da ke sama bisa la’akarin shawararmu, mun yanke shawarar zaɓar MySQL a matsayin DBMS ɗinmu don Aikin X. MySQL shahararren tsari ne na buɗaɗɗen tushe mai ƙarfin al’ummar ci gaba da babban tarin albarkatu don warware matsaloli da raba ilimi. An san shi da kyakkyawan aiki da iyawar faɗaɗuwa, wanda ya sa ya dace da sarrafa manyan adadin bayanai cikin inganci mai girma. Dandamalin yana da tsaro, aminci, kuma yana da faffadan siffofi masu muhimmanci ga aikinmu, ciki har da bin ACID don mu’amaloli, samfurin bayanai mai sassauci, da goyon baya ga harsunan shirye-shirye da tsarin aiki daban-daban. MySQL kuma yana dacewa da mafi yawan tarin fasaharmu, ciki har da tsarin yanar gizonmu, mafitar ɗaukar bayanai, da sauran muhimman kayan aiki. Haka kuma, sharuɗɗan kuɗinsa da lasisinsa suna da gasa idan aka kwatanta da sauran tsarukan mallaka kamar Oracle da Microsoft SQL Server. Sakamako Muna hasashen sakamako da tasirin shawararmu kamar haka: Masu kyau Babban aiki da iya faɗaɗuwa: MySQL yana ba da kyakkyawan aiki da iyawar faɗaɗuwa, wanda ya sa ya dace da sarrafa manyan adadin bayanai cikin inganci. Mai tsaro da aminci: MySQL yana ba da kyawawan siffofin tsaro da aminci, waɗanda suke da muhimmanci wajen sarrafa muhimman bayanai. Faffadan tallafin al’umma: MySQL yana da babbar al’umma da albarkatun intanet daban-daban, wanda ke sauƙaƙa neman taimako da warware matsaloli. Dacewa: MySQL yana dacewa da tarin fasaharmu da harsunan shirye-shirye, yana sauƙaƙa tsarin ci gabanmu. Marasa kyau Lokacin koyo: Ana iya samun lokacin koyo ga tawagar ci gaba, musamman waɗanda ba su da gogewa da MySQL da rumbun bayanai na SQL. Iyakoki: MySQL na iya samun wasu iyakoki wajen sarrafa wasu nau’ikan bayanai da sarƙaƙƙun samfuran bayanai, wanda ke buƙatar haɓakawa da inganta a hankali. Kammalawa Bisa bayanan da ake da su da la’akarin shawararmu, mun yi imanin cewa MySQL shi ne zaɓin da ya dace don tsarin sarrafa rumbun bayananmu na Aikin X. MySQL yana ba da babban aiki, aminci, tsaro, da iyawar faɗaɗuwa kuma yana dacewa sosai da tarin fasaharmu. Tawagar ci gaba za ta buƙaci saba da amfani da MySQL, amma tallafin al’umma da albarkatun da ake da su ya kamata su taimaka a wannan tsari. Yabo: ChatGPT ne ya samar da wannan shafi, sannan aka gyara shi don bayyanawa da tsari.

records.title: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: rumbun bayanai na PostgreSQL
headings: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: rumbun bayanai na PostgreSQL
records.text: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: rumbun bayanai na PostgreSQL Take: Amfani da Rumbun Bayanai na PostgreSQL Mahalli Ƙungiyarmu tana kimanta zaɓuɓɓuka a yanzu don tsarin sarrafa rumbun bayanai mafi dacewa da za a yi amfani da shi a aikinmu mai zuwa. Mun taƙaita bincikenmu zuwa zaɓuɓɓuka biyu – PostgreSQL da MySQL. Bayan tunani sosai, mun yanke shawarar amfani da PostgreSQL saboda ci-gaban siffofinsa da iyawar aikinsa. Shawara Za mu yi amfani da PostgreSQL a matsayin tsarin sarrafa rumbun bayanai da aka fi so don aikin ƙungiyarmu mai zuwa. Hujja Bayan nazari da kwatanta siffofin PostgreSQL da MySQL, mun kai ga ƙarshe cewa PostgreSQL shi ne mafi kyawun zaɓi saboda waɗannan dalilai: Ci-gaban siffofi: PostgreSQL yana da faffadan ci-gaban siffofi kamar tallafin JSON, bincike na cikakken rubutu, da sarrafa bayanan sarari, waɗanda suke da muhimmanci ga aikinmu. Aiki: PostgreSQL yana da tabbataccen tarihin kyakkyawar iyawar aiki, wanda zai tabbatar da cewa aikinmu yana tafiya lami lafiya ba tare da wata matsalar aiki ba. Tallafin al’umma: PostgreSQL yana da babbar al’umma mai aiki da ke ba da sabuntawa da tallafi akai-akai, wanda ke sauƙaƙa warware duk wata matsala da ta taso yayin matakin haɓaka aikin. Iya faɗaɗuwa: PostgreSQL yana da iya faɗaɗuwa sosai, kuma yana iya sarrafa bayanai masu yawa cikin sauƙi, wanda zai zama mai muhimmanci ga aikinmu. Tsaro: PostgreSQL yana da ingantaccen tsarin tsaro wanda zai tabbatar da cewa bayanan aikinmu suna da tsaro a kowane lokaci, kuma ya cika duk buƙatun tsaron ƙungiyarmu. Madadin Sauran zaɓin da muka yi la’akari da shi shi ne MySQL. MySQL ma tsarin sarrafa rumbun bayanai ne mai iyawa sosai, amma ba shi da wasu ci-gaban siffofi da PostgreSQL ke bayarwa, kuma iyawar aikinsa ba ta kai ta PostgreSQL ba. Kammalawa Bisa nazarinmu, mun yanke shawarar amfani da PostgreSQL a matsayin tsarin sarrafa rumbun bayanai da aka fi so don aikinmu mai zuwa. An yanke wannan shawara bayan tunani sosai, kuma mun yi imanin cewa zai taimaka mana mu cimma manufofin aikinmu cikin inganci da tasiri. Yabo: ChatGPT ne ya samar da wannan shafi, sannan aka gyara shi don bayyanawa da tsari.

records.title: Saitin sauye-sauyen muhalli
headings: Kayayyakin da aka samar masu alaƙa
records.text: Saitin sauye-sauyen muhalli Abubuwan da ke ciki: Taƙaitawa Matsala Shawara Matsayi Cikakkun bayanai Zato Ƙuntatawa Ra’ayoyi Hujja Tasiri Mai alaƙa Shawarwari masu alaƙa Buƙatu masu alaƙa Kayayyakin da aka samar masu alaƙa Ƙa’idoji masu alaƙa Bayanan kula Taƙaitawa Matsala Muna son aikace-aikacenmu su kasance masu saitawa fiye da kayayyakin da aka samar/binaries/tushe, ta yadda gini ɗaya zai iya yin aiki daban dangane da muhallin ɗora shi. Don cimma haka, muna son amfani da saitin sauye-sauyen muhalli. Muna son sarrafa saitin ta amfani da fayiloli da za mu iya sarrafa nau’insu. Muna son samar da wasu sauƙin ƙwarewar masu haɓakawa, kamar sanin abin da za a iya saitawa da duk wasu tsoffin ƙima masu dacewa. Shawara An yanke shawara kan fayilolin .env tare da fayil ɗin tsoffin ƙima da fayil ɗin tsari masu alaƙa. Matsayi An yanke shawara. A buɗe don la’akari da sababbin iyawa idan sun taso. Cikakkun bayanai Zato Muna fifita raba lambar aikace-aikace da lambar muhalli. Muna zaton aikace-aikacen yana buƙatar yin aiki daban a muhalli daban-daban, kamar muhallin ci gaba, muhallin gwaji, muhallin nuni, muhallin samarwa, da sauransu. Muna fifita ayyukan masana’antu na “12 factor app” kuma har ma fiye da haka aikin da ke da alaƙa na “15 factor app”. Da yawa daga cikin ayyukanmu na baya sun yi amfani da ƙa’idar fayil .env ko makamancin kundin .env . Akwai al’ada ta yau da kullum ta ajiye waɗannan a wajen sarrafa nau’i, kuma maimakon haka a yi amfani da wata hanya ta daban don ɗora su, sarrafa nau’insu, da kula da su. Ƙuntatawa Muna son ajiye sirri a wajen tsarin sarrafa nau’i (VCS) na sarrafa lambar tushe (SCM). Muna da niyyar dacewa da shahararrun tsarin manhaja da laburare. Misali, Node yana da module “dotenv” don karanta saitin sauye-sauyen muhalli. Ra’ayoyi Mun yi la’akari da hanyoyi kaɗan: Ajiye saiti a cikin aikace-aikacen kamar a fayil config.js . Ajiye saiti a cikin muhalli kamar a fayil .env . Ɗauko saiti daga wuri sananne kamar sabar lasisi. Hujja Mun zaɓi hanyar fayil .env saboda: Ta shahara, ciki har da tsakanin ƙwararru. Ta bi tsarin fayilolin .env waɗanda tawagoginmu suka yi amfani da su cikin nasara sau da yawa a ayyuka da yawa. Mai sauƙi ce. Musamman, mun yarda a yanzu da muhimman musanyar da muke gani, kamar rashin iyawar bincike idan aka kwatanta da hanyar sabar lasisi. Tasiri Muna buƙatar gano hanyar raba saitin sauye-sauyen muhalli da ke na jama’a daga duk wani sarrafa sirri. Mai alaƙa Shawarwari masu alaƙa Muna sa ran dukkan aikace-aikacenmu su yi amfani da wannan hanya. Za mu shirya haɓaka duk aikace-aikacenmu da ke amfani da hanya mara iyawa sosai, kamar rubuta ƙima kai tsaye a cikin binary ko lambar tushe. Za mu bar yadda yake duk aikace-aikacenmu da ke amfani da hanya mafi iyawa, kamar sabar lasisi. Buƙatu masu alaƙa Za mu ƙara iyawar devops don fayilolin, ciki har da hooks, gwaje-gwaje, da haɗewa ta ci gaba. Muna buƙatar horar da duk abokan tawagar masu haɓakawa kan wannan shawara. Kayayyakin da aka samar masu alaƙa Kowane wuri da muke ɗora zai buƙaci nasa fayil ɗin .env da fayiloli masu alaƙa. Ƙa’idoji masu alaƙa Mai sauƙin sakewa. Bayanan kula Misalin fayil .env : NAME=Alice Anderson EMAIL=alice@example.com Misalin fayil .env.defaults : NAME=Joe Doe EMAIL=joe@example.com Misalin fayil .env.schema da maɓallai kawai: NAME EMAIL

records.title: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: snake case ko camelCase don REST API?
headings: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: snake case ko camelCase don REST API?
records.text: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: snake case ko camelCase don REST API? Shawara: Za a yi amfani da ƙa’idar suna ta snake case don wuraren ƙarshe na REST API Matsayi: An karɓa Mahalli A ƙa’idojin suna na REST API, akwai nau’i biyu da suka shahara: snake case da camelCase. Tsarin snake case shi ne inda ake raba kowace kalma a cikin suna da alamar ƙasa (underscore), yayin da camelCase shi ne inda kalmar farko ta sunan take cikin ƙananan haruffa, kuma kalmomin da suka biyo baya haruffansu na farko manya ne. Wannan shawara za ta ƙayyade ƙa’idar sunan da ya kamata a yi amfani da ita don REST API. Abubuwan da ke Motsa Shawara Daidaito da ƙa’idojin suna da ke akwai a aikin Sauƙin karantawa da bayyanawa ga duk wanda zai iya aiki a kan API Daidaito da mafi kyawun ayyukan masana’antu na ƙa’idojin suna na REST API Sauƙin aiwatarwa da kulawa Shawara Za a yi amfani da ƙa’idar suna ta snake case don wuraren ƙarshe na REST API. Waɗannan abubuwa ne suka motsa wannan zaɓi: Daidaito : Aikin ya riga ya yi amfani da ƙa’idar suna ta snake case don duk wuraren ƙarshe, kuma zai yi amfani a kiyaye wannan ƙa’ida don tabbatar da daidaito a duk aikin. Sauƙin karantawa da bayyanawa : Ƙa’idar snake case ta fi sauƙin karantawa da fahimta. Alamomin ƙasa suna ba da bayyanannen rabuwa tsakanin kalmomi, wanda ke sauƙaƙa fahimtar ma’anar sunan. Daidaito da mafi kyawun ayyukan masana’antu : Ana amfani da ƙa’idar snake case sosai a masana’antu kuma ana ɗaukarta mafi kyawun aiki ga REST API, wanda ya sa ta zama zaɓi mai kyau ga aikin. Sauƙin aiwatarwa da kulawa : Ci gaba da ƙa’idar sunan da ke akwai ya fi sauƙin aiwatarwa da kulawa domin dole ne a sabunta duk lambar da takardun da ke akwai idan an zaɓi sabuwar ƙa’ida. Sakamako Akwai yiwuwar sakamako na wannan shawara. Idan wasu sababbin membobin tawaga da suka shiga aikin ba su saba da ƙa’idar suna ta snake case ba, hakan na iya haifar da ruɗani da kurakurai a ci gaba. Duk da haka, tun da snake case ƙa’ida ce da ake amfani da ita sosai, irin wannan haɗarin ƙanƙani ne. Idan ana amfani da wasu kayan aiki ko tsarin aiki a aikin waɗanda suka dogara sosai da ƙa’idar camelCase, hakan na iya buƙatar ƙarin ƙoƙari don sauya tsakanin ƙa’idojin suna. Duk da haka, ba damuwa ce mai girma ba domin aikin ya daidaita kan ƙa’idar snake case. A gaba ɗaya, shawarar amfani da ƙa’idar suna ta snake case don wuraren ƙarshe na REST API tana haifar da hanya mai daidaito, mai sauƙin karantawa, kuma ta ma’aunin masana’antu yayin da take da sauƙin aiwatarwa da kulawa. Yabo: ChatGPT ne ya samar da wannan shafi, sannan aka gyara shi don bayyanawa da tsari.

records.title: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: Tailwind CSS
records.text: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: Tailwind CSS Shawara: Yi amfani da Tailwind CSS a matsayin tsarin CSS don tsara fasalin mu’amalar mai amfani. Menene Tailwind CSS? Tailwind tsarin CSS ne na fifita kayan amfani (utility-first) wanda ke ba da damar haɓaka cikin sauri da keɓance mu’amalar masu amfani. An ƙirƙira shi don ya zama mai keɓancewa sosai kuma yana ba masu haɓakawa damar rubuta CSS mai sauƙi da inganci. Wannan tsari yana ba da jerin azuzuwan da aka riga aka ƙayyade don tsara fasalin UI cikin sauri sosai. Mahalli Muna gina aikace-aikacen yanar gizo don abokin ciniki wanda ke buƙatar mu’amalar mai amfani mai amsawa da keɓancewa. Abokin ciniki ya nemi tsara fasali mai daidaito da na zamani. Tawagar ci gaba tana da gogewa wajen amfani da CSS na musamman amma tana son bincika tsarin CSS da za su iya tanadin lokaci da ƙoƙari. Muna neman tsarin da ke da sauƙin amfani, mai keɓancewa, kuma yana da babbar al’umma don tallafi. Abubuwan da ke Motsa Shawara Mai sauƙin amfani: Muna son tsarin da ke da sauƙin koyo kuma za a iya haɗa shi cikin tsarin aikinmu na ci gaba. Mai keɓancewa: Muna son tsarin da za a iya keɓance shi don ya dace da jagororin alamar abokin ciniki da jigon sa. Tallafin babbar al’umma: Muna son tsarin da ke da al’umma mai aiki ta masu haɓakawa da masu zane waɗanda za su iya ba da taimako da albarkatu idan an buƙata. Tanadin lokaci: Muna son tsarin da zai iya tanadin lokaci da ƙoƙari wajen tsara fasalin UI. Zaɓuɓɓukan da Aka Yi La’akari Bootstrap: Shahararren tsarin CSS mai ɓangarori da yawa da aka riga aka gina da babbar al’umma ta masu haɓakawa. Foundation: Wani shahararren tsarin CSS wanda aka ƙirƙira don ci gaban wayar hannu da farko. Materialize: Tsarin CSS bisa harshen zane na Material Design na Google tare da ɓangarori da aka riga aka gina don haɓaka UI. Tailwind CSS: Tsarin CSS na fifita kayan amfani wanda ya mai da hankali kan keɓancewa da inganci. Sakamakon Shawara Bayan la’akari da zaɓuɓɓukan, mun yanke shawarar amfani da Tailwind CSS saboda waɗannan dalilai: Mai sauƙin amfani: Hanyar Tailwind mai sauƙi ce kuma mai sauƙin fahimta. Azuzuwan kayan amfaninsa suna sa gina UI ya fi sauri. Mai keɓancewa: Tailwind yana ba da damar keɓancewa ta hanyar samar da jerin fayilolin saiti da ke ba masu haɓakawa damar canza salon tsarin na asali cikin sauƙi. Tallafin babbar al’umma: Tailwind yana da al’umma mai aiki sosai ta masu haɓakawa da masu zane waɗanda koyaushe suke ƙirƙirar sababbin albarkatu, plugins, da kayan aiki. Tanadin lokaci: Tailwind na iya tanadin lokaci, yana ba masu haɓakawa damar mai da hankali kan sauran fannonin aikin. Za mu yi amfani da azuzuwan kayan amfani na Tailwind CSS don gina UI na aikinmu. Tawagar ci gaba za ta yi amfani da tsarinsa na zane na atomic da ɓangarori don rubuta lambar CSS mai inganci kuma mai iya faɗaɗuwa. Za mu yi amfani da samfuran Tailwind da aka riga aka gina da ɓangarorin gani don hanzarta tsarin ci gaba yayin da muke amfani da salo na musamman don dacewa da alamar da jigon abokin ciniki. Yabo: ChatGPT ne ya samar da wannan shafi, sannan aka gyara shi don bayyanawa da tsari.

records.title: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: tsara kwantena na Docker Swarm
headings: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: tsara kwantena na Docker Swarm
records.text: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: tsara kwantena na Docker Swarm Lambar Shawara: 001 Wanda Ya Yanke Shawara: [Sunanka ko matsayinka] Kwanan wata: [Kwanan watan shawara] Mahalli Muna la’akari da kayan aikin tsara kwantena daban-daban don sarrafa gine-ginenmu na tushen microservices. Mun kimanta mafita daban-daban kamar Kubernetes, Docker Swarm, da Mesosphere DC/OS. Duk da haka, mun yanke shawarar mai da hankali kan Docker Swarm saboda sauƙinsa, haɗewarsa da Docker, da daidaita nauyi na ciki. Shawara Mun yanke shawarar amfani da Docker Swarm a matsayin kayan aikin tsara kwantenanmu. Docker Swarm yana ba da hanya mai sauƙi kuma mai fahimta ta sarrafa aikace-aikacen da aka sa a kwantena a kan gungun nodes. Yana kuma ba mu damar amfani da tsarin aikinmu da kayayyakin more rayuwa na tushen Docker da muke da su. Da Docker Swarm, za mu iya ɗora, faɗaɗa, da sarrafa aikace-aikacenmu cikin sauƙi, tare da cin gajiyar daidaita nauyi na ciki. Fa’idodi Sauƙi: Docker Swarm yana bin ƙa’idodi iri ɗaya da Docker, don haka babu buƙatar koyon sabuwar fasaha. Lokacin koyo ɗan gajere ne ga masu haɓakawa da suka saba da Docker. Haɗewa: Docker Swarm yana haɗewa da kayan aikin Docker cikin sauƙi, kamar Docker Compose, wanda ke sauƙaƙa sarrafa dukkan kwantenanmu da ayyukanmu daga wuri ɗaya. Daidaita nauyi: Docker Swarm yana ba da daidaita nauyi na ciki, yana tabbatar da cewa aikace-aikacenmu koyaushe suna samuwa kuma an raba su daidai a gungun. Iya faɗaɗuwa: Docker Swarm yana sauƙaƙa faɗaɗa aikace-aikacenmu a kwance ta ƙara ko cire nodes daga gungun. Samuwa mai yawa: Docker Swarm yana rarraba ayyukanmu a nodes ta atomatik, yana ba da samuwa mai yawa idan wani node ya lalace. Haɗari Iyakantaccen aiki: Docker Swarm na iya rasa wasu ci-gaban siffofi da ake samu a Kubernetes ko Mesosphere DC/OS, kamar faɗaɗawa ta atomatik ko warkar da kai. Mai tsakiya a kan Docker: Docker Swarm yana da alaƙa mai ƙarfi da Docker, wanda zai iya iyakance sassaucinmu idan muka taɓa buƙatar bar mafita na tushen Docker. Rashin balaga: Docker Swarm har yanzu sabuwar fasaha ce, kuma ana iya samun wasu matsalolin dorewa ko gibi a takardu. Madadin Kubernetes: Kubernetes shi ne dandamalin tsara kwantena da aka fi amfani da shi kuma yana ba da ci-gaban siffofi da tsarin muhalli mafi balaga. Duk da haka, yana da lokacin koyo mai tsayi kuma yana iya zama fiye da buƙatunmu. Mesosphere DC/OS: Mesosphere DC/OS kayan aiki ne mai ƙarfi da ke ba da ci-gaban siffofi kamar goyon bayan girgije da yawa da iyawar dandamalin manyan bayanai da AI na asali. Duk da haka, yana buƙatar ƙwarewa mai yawa don aiwatarwa kuma yana iya zama mai sarƙaƙiya fiye da buƙatunmu. Kammalawa Bayan tunani sosai, mun yanke shawarar amfani da Docker Swarm a matsayin kayan aikin tsara kwantenanmu. Docker Swarm yana ba da sauƙi, haɗewa, da daidaita nauyi na ciki da muke buƙata don sarrafa aikace-aikacenmu da aka sa a kwantena. Ko da yake yana iya rasa wasu ci-gaban siffofi, mun yi imanin cewa fa’idodin Docker Swarm sun fi haɗarinsa don buƙatunmu na yanzu. Yabo: ChatGPT ne ya samar da wannan shafi, sannan aka gyara shi don bayyanawa da tsari.

records.title: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: tsara kwantena na Kubernetes
headings: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: tsara kwantena na Kubernetes
records.text: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: tsara kwantena na Kubernetes Bayanin Matsala Muna buƙatar zaɓar dandamalin tsara kwantena don tarin aikace-aikacenmu na girgije da ke girma. Ɗora tsarin dandamalinmu na tsohon zamani na yanzu yana da jinkiri sosai, kuma ba shi da sassauci don ci gaba da biyan buƙatunmu masu girma. Muna neman tsarin da zai ba mu damar faɗaɗa ayyukanmu ta hanya mafi inganci ba tare da rage sassauci ko sauƙin amfani ba. Madadin da Aka Yi La’akari Docker Swarm Kubernetes Apache Mesos Shawarar da Aka Yanke Bayan gudanar da cikakken nazarin kowane dandamalin tsara kwantena, mun yanke shawarar karɓar Kubernetes a matsayin mafi kyawun zaɓi ga buƙatun kamfaninmu. Dalilanmu na zaɓar Kubernetes su ne kamar haka: Iya Faɗaɗuwa: Ƙirar Kubernetes ta musamman ta dace da faɗaɗa aikace-aikace, kuma yayin da buƙatunmu na iya faɗaɗuwa ke canzawa a kan lokaci, Kubernetes yana da iyawa ta asali don biyan waɗannan canje-canje ba tare da wata matsala ba. Gine-gine Mara Tsakiya: Tsarin master-worker na Kubernetes yana tabbatar da gine-gine mara tsakiya wanda ke tabbatar da cewa babu wuri guda na gazawa. Tallafin Al’umma: Kubernetes yana da mafi girma kuma mafi aiki a al’ummar buɗaɗɗen tushe, wanda ke nufin yana da adadi mai yawa na masu ba da gudummawa, masu haɓakawa, da masu sayarwa, wanda ke sauƙaƙa mana samun taimako da albarkatu. Tallafin Tsarin Muhalli: Kubernetes yana da tsarin muhalli mai girma tare da kayan aiki daban-daban na wasu kamfanoni, haɗewa da rajistar kwantena, bututun CI/CD, ajiyar bayanai, da ƙari. Saboda haka, mun yanke shawarar karɓar Kubernetes a matsayin dandamalin tsara kwantenanmu a yanzu da nan gaba kaɗan. Yabo: ChatGPT ne ya samar da wannan shafi, sannan aka gyara shi don bayyanawa da tsari.

records.title: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: tsarin aikace-aikacen yanar gizo, cikakke, full stack, don samfurin sabuwar kamfani
headings: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: tsarin aikace-aikacen yanar gizo, cikakke, full stack, don samfurin sabuwar kamfani
records.text: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: tsarin aikace-aikacen yanar gizo, cikakke, full stack, don samfurin sabuwar kamfani Babban Manufa: Gina aikace-aikacen yanar gizo don abokan ciniki masu biyan kuɗi su shiga, ɗora fayiloli, sarrafa bayanai, da duba rahotanni, mai mai da hankali kan ci gaba mai sassauci, aiki na full-stack, da ƙarfi dacewa da kayan aikin AI/ML, musamman litattafan rubutu na Project Jupyter. Mahalli da Buƙatu: Ci Gaba Mai Sassauci (Fifiko Mai Girma) : A matsayin sabuwar kamfani, muna buƙatar saurin maimaitawa da sassauci. Ayyukan sassauci, kamar yin samfurin gwaji cikin sauri, ci gaba mai maimaitawa, da daidaitawa ga canji, su ne mabuɗin zagayen ci gabanmu. Tsarin Full-Stack (Fifiko Mai Girma) : Muna nufin rage nauyin aiki ta zaɓar tsarin da zai iya sarrafa na baya da na gaba duka yadda ya kamata, yana rage buƙatar tsarukan gaba daban. Dacewa da Kayan Aikin AI/ML (Fifiko Mai Girma) : Iya haɗewa cikin sauƙi da kayan aikin nazarin bayanai kamar litattafan rubutu na Jupyter da tsarin muhallin kimiyyar bayanai na Python (NumPy, Pandas, TensorFlow, da sauransu) yana da muhimmanci. Wannan zai sauƙaƙa sarrafa bayanai da rahotanni yadda ya kamata. Ma’aunin Ƙaramin Muhimmanci : Gudun Lokacin Aiki : Ko da yake aiki yana da dacewa, ba shi ne mafi muhimmanci a farko ba domin muna damuwa da saurin ci gaba da cikar siffofi. Iya Faɗaɗuwa : Muna hasashen girma, amma ana iya magance damuwar iya faɗaɗuwa daga baya, kuma ba babban buƙata ba ne yanzu. Dacewa da Baya : Muna mai da hankali kan fasahohin yanzu kuma ba mu damu sosai da dacewa da baya da tsoffin tsarukan ba. Tsarukan da Aka Kimanta: Django (Python) Ruby on Rails (Ruby) Phoenix (Elixir) Loco (Rust) --- Django (Python) Bayyani : Django tsarin yanar gizo ne na matakin sama na Python wanda ke haɓaka ci gaba cikin sauri da ƙira mai tsabta, mai amfani. An san shi da falsafar “cikakke” (“batteries included”), ma’ana ya haɗa da siffofi da yawa kamar tantancewa, hanyoyi, ORM, da sarrafa fom daga cikin akwatin. Ƙarfi : Full-Stack : Django cikakken tsari ne na full-stack wanda zai iya sarrafa buƙatun na baya da na gaba da siffofi da aka haɗa (misali, injin samfurin rubutu, mu’amalar admin). Ci Gaba Mai Sassauci : Tsari da ƙa’idojin Django da aka ayyana da kyau suna ba da damar ci gaba da sauri da daidaitawa, wanda yake da muhimmanci a muhallin sabuwar kamfani. Tsarin yana zuwa da kyawawan takardu da wadataccen tsarin muhalli na fakiti na wasu kamfanoni, wanda ke hanzarta ci gaba. Haɗewa da AI/ML : Tsarin muhallin Python ba shi da kamarsa idan ana maganar kimiyyar bayanai da koyon na’ura. Django, da yake na tushen Python ne, yana haɗewa cikin sauƙi da kayan aiki kamar litattafan rubutu na Jupyter, Pandas, NumPy, TensorFlow, da scikit-learn. Al’umma da Tsarin Muhalli : Django yana da babbar al’umma, ƙaƙƙarfan takardu, da faffadan plugins da kari, wanda ke hanzarta ci gaba da warware matsaloli sosai. Rauni : Gudun Lokacin Aiki : Python yakan zama a hankali idan aka kwatanta da harsuna kamar Rust ko Elixir. Duk da haka, ga wannan amfani, inda aiki ba shi ne babban damuwa ba, wannan bazai zama mai hana yarjejeniya ba. Iya Faɗaɗuwa : Ko da yake Django yana iya faɗaɗuwa sosai, ana iya samun ƙalubale a babban matakin ba tare da inganta a hankali ba (misali, lokacin sarrafa buƙatu masu yawa a lokaci ɗaya). Duk da haka, ana iya faɗaɗa Django yadda ya kamata ta amfani da daidaita nauyi da dabarun ajiyar wucin gadi. Hukunci : Django ya dace da buƙatun ci gaba mai sassauci, goyon bayan full-stack, da dacewa da AI/ML. Haɗewarsa da Python tana ba da damar shiga cikin sauƙi ga kayan aikin kimiyyar bayanai da laburare da ake buƙata don aikace-aikacen. --- Ruby on Rails (Ruby) Bayyani : Ruby on Rails (RoR) balagagge ne, cikakken tsarin aikace-aikacen yanar gizo na full-stack da aka san shi da hanyar ƙa’ida-fiye-da-saiti, wadda ke sauƙaƙa ci gaba cikin sauri. Ƙarfi : Full-Stack : RoR yana zuwa da kayan aiki na ciki don ci gaban na baya da na gaba duka (misali, views, samfuran rubutu, scaffolding), kuma wadataccen laburarensa na gems yana ba da damar aiwatar da siffofi daban-daban da sauri. Ci Gaba Mai Sassauci : Ruby on Rails an san shi musamman da zagayen maimaitawa masu sauri, wanda yake da fa’ida ga sabbin kamfanoni da ke son maimaita siffofi cikin sauri. RoR yana goyon bayan ci gaba mai jagorantar gwaji (TDD) kuma yana da kafaffen tsarin muhalli don tsarin aiki masu sassauci. Al’umma da Tsarin Muhalli : RoR yana da kafaffiyar al’umma mai ƙarfi da faffadan gems waɗanda zasu iya hanzarta ci gaba. Sauƙin Amfani : Rails yana da tsarin rubutu mai sauƙi ga masu haɓakawa kuma an san shi da sa ayyuka kamar komawar rumbun bayanai, gine-ginen model-view-controller (MVC), da sarrafa hanyoyi su zama masu sauri da sauƙi. Rauni : Aiki : Ruby yakan samu jinkirin aikin lokacin aiki idan aka kwatanta da Python ko Elixir. Ko da yake RoR na iya faɗaɗuwa da kayayyakin more rayuwa da suka dace, aikin Ruby na iya zama cikas ga aikace-aikacen da ke buƙatar sarrafa lokaci-na-gaske mai nauyi ko zirga-zirga mai yawa a lokaci ɗaya. Haɗewa da AI/ML : Ko da yake Ruby yana da wasu laburaren koyon na’ura, ba a karɓe shi sosai a al’ummar AI/ML kamar Python ba. Haɗewa da kayan aiki kamar litattafan rubutu na Jupyter ba ta da santsi, wanda ya sa Python ya zama zaɓi mafi ƙarfi ga aikace-aikace masu yawan bayanai. Hukunci : Ko da yake Ruby on Rails ya yi fice a ci gaba mai sassauci da yin samfurin gwaji cikin sauri, ya gaza a dacewa da AI/ML idan aka kwatanta da Python (Django). Zaɓi ne mai yiwuwa ga sabbin kamfanoni da ke fifita maimaitawa cikin sauri fiye da haɗewa mai zurfi ta nazarin bayanai. --- Phoenix (Elixir) Bayyani : Phoenix tsarin yanar gizo ne da aka gina da Elixir, harshen shirye-shirye mai aiki (functional) da aka ƙirƙira don iya faɗaɗuwa da aiki a lokaci ɗaya. Phoenix yana amfani da Erlang VM, wanda aka san shi da sarrafa manyan ayyuka a lokaci ɗaya da tsarukan masu jure kuskure. Ƙarfi : Iya Faɗaɗuwa da Aiki : Phoenix yana haskakawa a iya faɗaɗuwa da sarrafa aiki mai yawa a lokaci ɗaya. An gina shi a kan Erlang VM, wanda zai iya tallafawa dubbai (ko ma miliyoyi) na haɗi a lokaci ɗaya, wanda ya sa shi ɗan takara mai ƙarfi ga aikace-aikacen da ke buƙatar sarrafa bayanai a lokaci-na-gaske ko zirga-zirga mai yawa. Full-Stack : Phoenix ya haɗa da duk abin da ake buƙata don gina na baya da na gaba na aikace-aikace. Yana goyon bayan live views don sabuntawar UI mai mu’amala kuma ya haɗa da injin samfurin rubutu. Ci Gaba Mai Sassauci : Phoenix yana da ɓangarori da yawa, yana ba da damar maimaita siffofi cikin sauri. Ya dace sosai da sabbin kamfanoni da ke buƙatar motsawa da sauri. Dacewa da AI/ML : Ko da yake Elixir yana da laburaren koyon na’ura masu tasowa, ba a goyon bayansa sosai ga ayyukan AI/ML kamar Python ba. Haɗewa da kayan aiki kamar litattafan rubutu na Jupyter zai buƙaci mafita na gefe, domin tsarin muhallin Elixir na kimiyyar bayanai bai balaga kamar na Python ba. Rauni : Tsarin Muhallin AI/ML : Elixir ba shi ne babban harshen da ake amfani da shi a kimiyyar bayanai ko koyon na’ura ba, kuma tsarin muhallin bai balaga kamar na Python ba. Don haka, haɗewa da kayan aiki kamar litattafan rubutu na Jupyter ko shahararrun laburaren AI (TensorFlow, PyTorch) zai zama mai wahala. Lokacin Koyo : Idan tawagar ba ta saba da shirye-shirye masu aiki (functional) da Elixir ba, ana iya samun lokacin koyo mai tsayi. Hukunci : Phoenix zaɓi ne mai kyau idan iya faɗaɗuwa da aiki a lokaci ɗaya su ne babban damuwa. Duk da haka, idan aka yi la’akari da fifikon dacewa da AI/ML, Phoenix bazai zama mafi dacewa ba saboda iyakantaccen tsarin muhallin Elixir a wannan fanni. --- Loco (Rust) Bayyani : Loco tsarin yanar gizo ne da aka gina da Rust, harshen shirye-shiryen tsarukan da aka san shi da aiki, amincin ƙwaƙwalwa, da aiki a lokaci ɗaya. Rust yana ƙara shahara wajen gina aikace-aikace masu babban aiki. Ƙarfi : Aiki : Babban ƙarfin Rust yana cikin babban aikinsa da amincin ƙwaƙwalwa, wanda ya sa shi zaɓi mai kyau ga aikace-aikacen da ke buƙatar ikon ƙaramin matakin ko babban aiki na ban mamaki. Aiki a Lokaci Ɗaya : Tsarin mallaka na Rust yana tabbatar da amincin ƙwaƙwalwa yayin da yake ba da damar shirye-shirye masu aiki a lokaci ɗaya cikin aminci, wanda ya sa ya dace da tsarukan da ke buƙatar faɗaɗuwa yadda ya kamata da sarrafa daidaita aiki. Rauni : Ci Gaban Full-Stack : Loco, ko da yake yana da alƙawari, bai balaga kamar sauran tsarukan ba wajen samar da cikakkiyar mafitar full-stack. Ya fi dacewa da ci gaban na baya, kuma tsarin muhallin na gaba da ke kewaye da Rust har yanzu yana tasowa. Ci Gaba Mai Sassauci : Ci gaba da Rust na iya zama a hankali idan aka kwatanta da harsunan matakin sama kamar Python ko Ruby saboda yanayinsa na ƙaramin matakin da lokacin koyo mai tsayi. Tsarin Muhallin AI/ML : Rust ba shi da faffadan tsarin muhalli na AI/ML kamar Python. Ko da yake akwai laburare masu girma a Rust don lissafin lambobi, sun fi rashin balaga sosai fiye da abin da Python ke bayarwa, kamar litattafan rubutu na Jupyter ko tsarukan koyon na’ura. Hukunci : Ko da yake Rust da tsarinsa Loco suna ba da aiki na musamman, rashin goyon bayan full-stack, fa’idodin ci gaba mai sassauci, da tsarin muhallin AI/ML ya sa bai dace sosai da wannan takamaiman amfani ba. Ya fi dacewa da aikace-aikace masu muhimmancin aiki fiye da saurin ci gaban yanar gizo tare da kayan aikin kimiyyar bayanai da aka haɗa. --- Kammalawa Bayan kimanta zaɓuɓɓukan bisa buƙatun aikin, Django (Python) shi ne zaɓi mafi dacewa. Yana ba da fa’idodi masu zuwa: Iyawar Full-Stack : Django tsarin full-stack ne wanda ke haɗa ci gaban na baya da na gaba. Ci Gaba Mai Sassauci : Tsarin ya dace sosai da yin samfurin gwaji da maimaitawa cikin sauri, wanda yake da muhimmanci a muhallin sabuwar kamfani. Dacewa da AI/ML : Python shi ne babban harshe a AI/ML, kuma dacewar Django da laburare kamar litattafan rubutu na Jupyter tana tabbatar da haɗewa mai santsi don nazari da sarrafa bayanai. Al’umma da Tsarin Muhalli : Ƙarfin tallafin al’ummar Django da faffadan tsarin muhallin laburare suna ba da kayan aiki da yawa don hanzarta ci gaba. Ko da yake Ruby on Rails ma mai takara ne mai ƙarfi ga ci gaba mai sassauci, iyakantaccen goyon bayan AI/ML ɗinsa ya sa bai dace sosai da wannan takamaiman amfani ba. Phoenix (Elixir) da Loco (Rust) , ko da yake sun yi kyau don iya faɗaɗuwa da aiki, sun gaza a haɗewar AI/ML da ci gaban full-stack. Saboda haka, Django shi ne tsarin da aka ba da shawara ga wannan aiki.

records.title: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: tsarin CSS
headings: Kayayyakin da aka samar masu alaƙa
records.text: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: tsarin CSS Abubuwan da ke ciki: Taƙaitawa Matsala Shawara Matsayi Cikakkun bayanai Zato Ƙuntatawa Ra’ayoyi Hujja Tasiri Mai alaƙa Shawarwari masu alaƙa Buƙatu masu alaƙa Kayayyakin da aka samar masu alaƙa Ƙa’idoji masu alaƙa Bayanan kula Taƙaitawa Matsala Muna son amfani da tsarin CSS don ƙirƙirar aikace-aikacen yanar gizonmu: Muna son ƙwarewar mai amfani ta kasance mai sauri da aminci, a dukkan shahararrun burauza da girman allo. Muna son saurin maimaitawa a zane, tsari, UI/UX, da sauransu. Muna son aikace-aikace masu amsawa, musamman ga ƙananan allo kamar na na’urorin hannu, manyan allo kamar na 4K masu faɗi, da allo masu motsi kamar na’urorin nuni masu juyawa. Shawara An yanke shawara kan Bulma. Matsayi An yanke shawara kan Bulma. A buɗe ga sababbin zaɓuɓɓukan tsarin CSS idan suka zo. Cikakkun bayanai Zato Muna son ƙirƙirar aikace-aikacen yanar gizo na zamani, masu sauri, masu aminci, masu amsawa, da sauransu. Aikace-aikacen yanar gizo na zamani na yau da kullum suna rage/kawar da amfani da jQuery saboda dalilai da yawa: JavaScript na zamani yana shigo da iyawa da yawa waɗanda jQuery ya bayar, don haka jQuery ba a buƙatarsa sosai, kuma akwai ɓangarori mafi kyau/sauri/ƙanana waɗanda ke ba da takamaiman aiwatarwa Hanyar jQuery mai faɗi ita ce yin sarrafa DOM kai tsaye, wanda ya saɓa wa tsarin tsarukan JavaScript na zamani (misali React, Vue, Svelte) jQuery yana kawo cikas ga kansa idan an ɗora shi sau biyu, da sauransu. Ƙuntatawa Idan muka zaɓi tsarin CSS da ke amfani da jQuery, to mun makale da shigo da jQuery. Misali, Semantic UI yana amfani da jQuery, Tachyons kuma ba ya yi. Idan muka zaɓi tsarin CSS mai ƙaranci, to mun bar ɓangarorin tsarin da za mu so a yanzu ko nan ba da jimawa ba. Misali, Semantic UI yana ba da carousel na hotuna, Tachyons kuma ba ya yi. Ra’ayoyi Mun yi la’akari da rashin amfani da kowane tsari. Wannan har yanzu yana da yiwuwa, musamman domin CSS grid yana ba da yawancin abin da muke bukata don aikinmu.. Mun yi la’akari da tsarukan CSS da yawa ta amfani da gajeren jerin tantancewa cikin sauri: Bootstrap, Bulma, Foundation, Materialize, Semantic UI, Tachyons, da sauransu. Zaɓuɓɓukanmu biyu don bita mai zurfi su ne Semantic UI (domin yana da hanya mafi ma’ana) da Bulma (domin yana da hanya mafi sauƙin nauyi wadda ke ba da ɓangarorin da muke so a yanzu). Mun yi la’akari da Semantic UI. Wannan yana ba da ɓangarori da yawa, ciki har da waɗanda muke so don aikinmu: tabs, grids, buttons, da sauransu. Mun yi gwaji da Semantic UI ta hanyoyi biyu: ta amfani da fayilolin CDN na yau da kullum, da ta amfani da ma’ajiyar NPM. Mun sami nasara da Semantic UI a shafin HTML mai tsayawa, amma ba mu sami nasara ba cikin iyakar lokacinmu na gina SPA na JavaScript (galibi saboda matsalolin ɗora jQuery). Mun gano cewa wasu masu rubuta lamba sun kasance suna roƙon masu haɓaka Semantic UI su ƙirƙiri sigar da ba ta da jQuery, saboda dalilai iri ɗaya da namu. Wasu masu rubuta lamba sun kasance suna neman sigar da ba ta da jQuery tsawon shekaru da yawa, amma masu haɓakawa sun ce a’a, kuma sun bayyana cewa duk wata sigar da ba ta da jQuery za ta yi wahalar rubutawa misali “aikin Semantic UI yana da fiye da wuraren taɓawa 22,000 da ke amfani da jQuery”. Misali da Semantic: Alpha Bravo Mun yi la’akari da Bulma. Bulma yana da iyawa da yawa iri ɗaya da Semantic UI, ko da yake ba ɓangarori masu ci-gaba sosai kamar yawansu ba. An gina Bulma da dabaru na zamani, kamar rashin jQuery. Bulma yana da wasu ɓangarori na wasu kamfanoni, wasu daga cikinsu za mu so mu yi amfani da su. Misali da Bulma: Alpha Bravo Hujja Kamar yadda ke sama. Musamman, Semantic UI yana da alamar taka tsantsan duka a fannin fasaha (wato wuraren taɓawa na jQuery da yawa) da kuma a fannin shugabanci (wato rashin jQuery ya sami “a’a” mai tsauri, maimakon ƙoƙarin taswirar hanya, ko ci gaba mai dorewa, ko tara gudummawa, da sauransu). Tasiri Idan muka sami tsarin CSS mai kyau wanda ba na jQuery ba, wannan gabaɗaya yana da amfani da kyau. Mai alaƙa Shawarwari masu alaƙa Tsarin CSS da muka zaɓa na iya shafar sauƙin gwaji. Buƙatu masu alaƙa Muna son jigilar aikace-aikace na zamani tsantsa cikin sauri. Ba ma son kashe lokaci muna aiki a kan tsofaffin tsarukan (musamman Semantic UI) masu amfani da tsofaffin dogaro (musamman jQuery). Kayayyakin da aka samar masu alaƙa Yana shafar dukkan HTML na yau da kullum da zai yi amfani da CSS. Ƙa’idoji masu alaƙa Mai sauƙin sakewa. Buƙatar sauri. Bayanan kula Kowane bayanin kula a nan.

records.title: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine don tsarin Python Django
headings: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine don tsarin Python Django
records.text: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine don tsarin Python Django Ranar Shawara: 2021-07-15 Matsayi: An karɓa Mahalli Ƙungiyarmu tana shirin haɓaka aikace-aikacen yanar gizo da ke sarrafa bayanan abokan ciniki. Mun zaɓi Python a matsayin harshen shirye-shirye kuma muna la’akari da Django a matsayin tsarin yanar gizo don haɓaka aikace-aikacen. Shawara Mun yanke shawarar amfani da tsarin yanar gizo na Django don haɓaka aikace-aikacen yanar gizo. Django yana ba da ƙaƙƙarfan jerin kayan aiki da siffofi don gina aikace-aikacen yanar gizo cikin sauri da inganci. Abubuwa Wasu daga cikin abubuwan da suka rinjayi shawararmu sun haɗa da: Taswirar Abu-Dangantaka (ORM): Django yana da ORM na ciki wanda ke ba mu damar yin mu’amala da rumbun bayanai ba tare da rubuta tambayoyin SQL ba. Wannan yana sauƙaƙa haɓaka aikace-aikacen da kulawa da shi a dogon lokaci. Tsarin MVC: Django yana bin gine-ginen Model-View-Controller (MVC), wanda ke sauƙaƙa raba dabarar kasuwanci da yadudduka na gabatarwa na aikace-aikacen. Iya faɗaɗuwa: An san Django da iyawar faɗaɗuwa, wanda ya sa ya zama kyakkyawan zaɓi don haɓaka manyan aikace-aikace. Tsaro: Django yana da siffofin tsaro na ciki, kamar kariya daga hare-haren yanar gizo na gama gari kamar cross-site scripting (XSS) da SQL injection. Tallafin Al’umma: Django yana da babbar al’umma mai aiki da ke ba da tallafi kuma tana ba da gudummawa ga ci gaban tsarin. Madadin da Aka Yi La’akari Mun yi la’akari da wasu tsarin yanar gizo kamar Flask da Pyramid. Duk da haka, mun ga cewa Django tsari ne mafi balagagge kuma ingantacce mai ƙaƙƙarfan jerin siffofi. Mun kuma tattauna haɓaka aikace-aikacen ba tare da tsarin yanar gizo ba da amfani da laburare kamar SQLAlchemy da Flask-RESTful. Duk da haka, mun ga cewa Django yana ba da faffadan ayyuka, wanda ya sa ya zama mafi kyawun zaɓi ga cikakken aikace-aikacen yanar gizo. Sakamako Karɓar Django zai haifar da waɗannan sakamako: Mafi sauƙin haɓakawa da kula da aikace-aikacen saboda kayan aiki da siffofin Django na ciki. Raba dabarar kasuwanci da yadudduka na gabatarwa, wanda ke kai wa ga lamba mafi tsari kuma mafi sauƙin kulawa. Iya faɗaɗuwa da ƙarfin aikace-aikacen. Siffofin tsaro na ciki waɗanda ke taimakawa kare aikace-aikacen daga hare-haren yanar gizo na gama gari. Samun damar shiga babbar al’umma mai aiki don tallafi. Mun fahimci cewa Django yana da lokacin koyo mai tsayi fiye da sauran tsarin aiki, amma mun ga ya cancanci saka hannun jari saboda fa’idodin dogon lokaci da yake bayarwa. Kammalawa Bisa abubuwan da aka yi la’akari da su, mun yanke shawarar amfani da tsarin yanar gizo na Django don haɓaka aikace-aikacen yanar gizo. Mun yi imanin cewa siffofin Django, tallafin al’umma, da iyawar faɗaɗuwa sun sa ya zama mafi kyawun zaɓi don gina cikakken aikace-aikacen yanar gizo. Za mu horar da masu haɓakawanmu su yi amfani da Django don tabbatar da cewa ana amfani da tsarin yadda ya kamata kuma cikin inganci.

records.title: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: tsarin Ruby on Rails
headings: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: tsarin Ruby on Rails
records.text: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: tsarin Ruby on Rails Mahalli Ƙungiyar tana haɓaka aikace-aikacen yanar gizo mai sarƙaƙƙen dabarar kasuwanci da haɗewa da yawa da sabis na wasu kamfanoni. Tawagar tana da gogewa wajen gina aikace-aikacen yanar gizo da Ruby on Rails. Akwai buƙatar zaɓar tsarin yanar gizo wanda ke haɓaka ci gaba cikin sauri, iya faɗaɗuwa, da sauƙin kulawa. Shawara Yi amfani da Ruby on Rails a matsayin tsarin haɓaka aikace-aikacen yanar gizon. Hujja Ruby on Rails tsarin yanar gizo ne balagagge, mai dorewa, kuma wanda ake amfani da shi sosai wanda ya tabbatar da tasirinsa wajen gina sarƙaƙƙen aikace-aikacen yanar gizo. Tsarin yana bin tsarin gine-gine na Model-View-Controller (MVC), wanda ke haɓaka raba damuwa da ƙara sake amfani da lamba da sauƙin kulawa. Rails yana ba da siffofi da yawa na ciki, kamar ActiveRecord don mu’amalar rumbun bayanai da ActionMailer don sarrafa imel, waɗanda za su iya tanadin lokacin ci gaba da sauƙaƙa lamba. Tsarin yana da babbar al’umma mai aiki, tare da ɓangarori da plugins da yawa masu sake amfani don haɓaka aiki da warware matsalolin gama gari. Ruby on Rails yana goyon bayan Ci Gaban Mai Jagorantar Gwaji (TDD) da Ci Gaban Mai Jagorantar Hali (BDD), wanda ke ba masu haɓakawa damar rubuta gwaje-gwaje na atomatik don lambarsu, yana tabbatar da cewa tana aiki kamar yadda ake tsammani da rage kurakurai da komawa baya. Ruby harshe ne na matakin sama wanda ke haɓaka aikin masu haɓakawa da sauƙin karanta lamba, kuma yana aiki a matsayin ƙaƙƙarfan harshen manne don haɗewa da faffadan sabis da API na wasu kamfanoni. Sakamako Tawagar tana buƙatar tabbatar da cewa gine-gine da ƙirar aikace-aikacen yanar gizon suna bin ƙa’idodi da mafi kyawun ayyuka na Rails don ƙara cin gajiyar tsarin. Masu haɓakawa suna buƙatar fahimtar harshen Ruby da tsarin Rails sosai, ko da yake takardun Rails da al’umma na iya ba da jagora da tallafi. Wataƙila akwai lokacin koyo ga masu haɓakawa sababbi ga Ruby da Rails, ko da yake fa’idodin tsarin na iya tabbatar da saka hannun jari a horo da karɓar sababbin ma’aikata. Tawagar tana buƙatar sa ido kan aiki da iya faɗaɗuwar aikace-aikacen, kuma tana iya buƙatar gyara tambayoyin rumbun bayanai da inganta ajiyar wucin gadi don sarrafa bayanai da zirga-zirga masu yawa. Yabo: ChatGPT ne ya samar da wannan shafi, sannan aka gyara shi don bayyanawa da tsari.

records.title: tsarin-sarrafa-burauza-don-gwajin-e2e-playwright-ko-selenium
headings: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: tsarin sarrafa burauza don gwajin E2E (Playwright ko Selenium)
records.text: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: tsarin sarrafa burauza don gwajin E2E (Playwright ko Selenium) Mahalli Muna cikin tsarin zaɓar tsarin sarrafa burauza don bututun gwajin ƙarshe-zuwa-ƙarshe (E2E) ɗinmu. Wannan tsari zai zama wani muhimmin ɓangare na tsarin CI/CD ɗinmu, yana gudanar da gwaje-gwajen da ke kwaikwayon mu’amalar masu amfani na zahiri a dandamalinmu. Musamman, gwaje-gwajen za su rufe yanayuka kamar rajista/shigar mai amfani, ɗora fayiloli, mu’amalar dashboard, da zazzage rahotanni. A matsayin sabuwar kamfani , mai da hankalinmu yana kan ci gaba mai sassauci , tare da buƙatar maimaitawa da haɓaka cikin sauri. Tawagarmu galibi tana aiki da TypeScript da Python , kuma iya rubuta gwaje-gwaje a waɗannan harsuna yana da muhimmanci. Bugu da ƙari, dandamalin yana ɗauke da zane-zane da dashboards masu mu’amala , wanda ya sa yana da muhimmanci kayan aikin sarrafa ya goyi bayan UI masu wadata, masu motsi da kyau. Masu takara biyu na wannan aiki su ne Playwright da Selenium , kowanne da ƙarfinsa da musanyarsa. Muna buƙatar kimanta waɗannan tsarukan bisa siffofi da buƙatun da aka bayyana a ƙasa. Zaɓuɓɓukan da Aka Yi La’akari Playwright (na Microsoft) Selenium (na Aikin Selenium) Abubuwan da ke Motsa Shawara Abubuwan da ke tasiri a kan shawararmu su ne kamar haka: Ci Gaba Mai Sassauci : Kayan aikin da aka zaɓa dole ne ya ba da damar zagayen ci gaba masu sauri, masu sassauci. Goyon Bayan Harshe : Tawagarmu tana buƙatar goyon baya ga TypeScript da Python duka. Gwajin UI Mai Mu’amala : Iya gwada zane-zane masu mu’amala, dashboards, da abubuwa masu motsi cikin aminci yana da muhimmanci. Gudun Lokacin Aiki : Ko da yake ba babban damuwa ba ne, aiki a bututun CI/CD wani abin la’akari ne. Iya Faɗaɗuwa : Ba ma shirin faɗaɗawa mai yawa nan gaba kaɗan, amma muna son tabbatar da cewa mafita za ta iya ɗaukar girma a nan gaba. Dacewa da Baya : Tsoffin tsarukan da dacewa da tsoffin burauza ba su da muhimmanci ga aikinmu a wannan lokaci. Gwajin Wayar Hannu : Ko da yake ba mai da hankali na kai tsaye ba ne, ya kamata tsarin ya iya gwada siffofi masu dacewa da wayar hannu ko ya kasance mai faɗaɗuwa don irin waɗannan amfani. Gwajin Allo Da Yawa : Goyon baya ga saitunan allo da yawa buƙata ce ta biyu, musamman idan har muka taɓa faɗaɗa zuwa gwajin hanyoyin aiki na masu amfani masu sarƙaƙiya. Gwajin Ɗora Fayiloli : Dole ne tsarin ya sarrafa ɗora fayiloli yadda ya kamata, babbar buƙata ta buƙatun gwajinmu. Ma’aunin Kimantawa Sauƙin Amfani : Yaya sauƙin rubutawa da kula da gwaje-gwaje? Goyon Bayan Harshe : Shin tsarin yana goyon bayan TypeScript da Python, harsuna biyu da tawagarmu ke amfani da su sosai? Gwajin UI Mai Mu’amala : Yaya tsarin ke sarrafa sarƙaƙƙun mu’amalar masu amfani kamar zane-zane, ɗora fayiloli, da bayanai masu motsi? Haɗewar CI/CD : Yaya tsarin ke haɗewa da kayan aiki da ayyukan CI/CD na yau da kullum? Goyon Bayan Burauza Da Yawa : Waɗanne burauza ake goyon baya kuma yaya suke aiki? Aiki Da Gudu : Yaya sauri gwaje-gwaje ke gudana, musamman a bututun CI/CD? Iya Faɗaɗuwa : Yaya tsarin zai iya faɗaɗuwa idan aka ƙara gwaje-gwaje ko yanayuka masu sarƙaƙiya? Al’umma Da Tsarin Muhalli : Yaya al’ummar tsarin ke aiki? Akwai haɗewa da kari da yawa? La’akari 5.1 Playwright Fa’idodi : API Mai Wayo Don Ɗora Fayiloli Na Gida : API ɗin Playwright don mu’amala da fayilolin gida da yin ɗora fayiloli ya fi sauƙi kuma mai fahimta. Wannan zai sauƙaƙa aiwatarwa da kula da gwajin ɗora fayiloli. Tsarin Rubutu Da Samar Da Lamba : Playwright yana da tsarin rubutu mafi gajarta, mafi taƙaitawa. Wannan yana haifar da ƙarancin lambar boilerplate, wanda ke inganta sauƙin kulawa da ingancin mai haɓakawa. Bugu da ƙari, wannan gajeren tsarin rubutu yana inganta ingancin samar da lamba ta OpenAI, wanda ke sauƙaƙa samar da rubutun gwaji ta atomatik. Gwajin UI Mai Mu’amala : Playwright ya yi fice wajen gwada aikace-aikacen yanar gizo masu motsi, masu mu’amala, kamar waɗanda ke da zane-zane masu wadata, sarƙaƙƙun mu’amalar masu amfani, da sabuntawa a lokaci-na-gaske. Yana sarrafa WebSockets, WebRTC, shadow DOMs, da sauran fasahohin yanar gizo na zamani sosai. Goyon Bayan Burauza Da Yawa : Playwright yana goyon bayan Chromium , WebKit , da Firefox . Yana da aiki mai daidaito a waɗannan burauza, wanda ya kamata ya rufe mafi yawan buƙatun gwajinmu. Haɗewar CI/CD : Playwright yana haɗewa cikin sauƙi da dandamalan CI/CD na zamani (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, da sauransu). Yana iya gudanar da gwaje-gwaje a layi ɗaya a burauza daban-daban, yana inganta lokutan gudanar da gwaji kuma ya sa ya dace da ci gaba cikin sauri. Mai Sauri Kuma Amintacce : Playwright ya fi Selenium sauri gabaɗaya, musamman a yanayin headless, kuma ya fi juriya wajen mu’amala da abubuwan yanar gizo marasa daidaitawa. Rashin Fa’idodi : Iyakantaccen Gwajin Wayar Hannu : Ko da yake Playwright yana goyon bayan kwaikwayon wayar hannu don burauza, ba shi da iyawar gwajin wayar hannu ta asali kamar haɗewar Selenium da Appium don gwajin wayar hannu na gaske. Ƙaramin Tsarin Muhalli : Playwright har yanzu sabo ne kuma bai kafu ba kamar Selenium. Ko da yake yana da al’umma mai saurin girma da kyawawan takardu, wataƙila bai riga ya sami faffadan tsarin muhalli na plugins da haɗewa da Selenium ke bayarwa ba. Iyakantaccen Goyon Bayan Burauza : Ko da yake Playwright yana rufe manyan burauza na zamani (Chrome, Safari, Firefox), goyon bayansa ga tsoffin burauza (misali, Internet Explorer) bai kai na Selenium ƙarfi ba. 5.2 Selenium Fa’idodi : Tsawon Tarihi Da Balaga : Selenium ya daɗe yana nan kuma yana da tabbataccen tarihin aiki. Ana amfani da shi sosai a tawagogi da masana’antu da yawa, wanda ya haifar da faffadan tsarin muhalli na plugins, haɗewa, da albarkatu. Goyon Bayan Burauza Da Dandamali Da Yawa : Selenium yana goyon bayan burauza da sigogi iri-iri , ciki har da Internet Explorer , kuma ana iya haɗa shi da kayan aiki daban-daban kamar Docker , Selenium Grid , da sabis na girgije don gwajin rarrabawa. Gwajin Wayar Hannu : Selenium, ta hanyar haɗewarsa da Appium , ya fi ƙarfi sosai don gwajin wayar hannu, ciki har da aikace-aikacen Android da iOS. Wannan ya sa ya zama mafi kyawun zaɓi ga ayyukan da suka mai da hankali kan wayar hannu ko suna da yawan wayar hannu. Gwajin Allo Da Yawa : Selenium yana ba da mafi kyawun goyon baya ga yanayuka da suka haɗa da allo da yawa ko sarƙaƙƙun mu’amalar tagogi da yawa. Rashin Fa’idodi : Sarƙaƙiya : API ɗin Selenium ya fi tsayi kuma a bayyane. Ko da yake wannan na iya zama fa’ida a wasu lokuta, yana nufin ƙarin lambar da za a rubuta da kula, wanda zai iya rage sassaucin mai haɓakawa—musamman muhimmi a muhallin sabuwar kamfani. Aiki : Selenium gabaɗaya yana gudana a hankali fiye da Playwright, musamman a yanayin headless. Wannan zai iya shafar bututun CI/CD, musamman yayin da adadin gwaje-gwaje ke girma. Gwajin UI Mai Mu’amala : Selenium ba shi da santsi kamar Playwright wajen gwada UI na yanar gizo na zamani, masu mu’amala, musamman da zane-zane da sabuntawar bayanai a lokaci-na-gaske. Yana buƙatar ƙarin saiti da sarrafawa don mu’amala da abun ciki mai motsi cikin aminci. Taƙaitaccen Kwatance Siffa Playwright Selenium ----------------------------------- ----------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------- Sauƙin Amfani Gajeren tsarin rubutu, mafi fahimta ga UI na zamani Ya fi bayyane, yana buƙatar ƙarin boilerplate Goyon Bayan Harshe TypeScript, Python, JavaScript TypeScript, Python, Java, Ruby, C# Gwajin UI Mai Mu’amala Mai kyau sosai ga UI masu motsi, na lokaci-na-gaske Yana sarrafa UI na asali, amma ya fi tsayi da sarƙaƙiya ga mu’amala masu wadata Gwajin Ɗora Fayiloli API mai wayo don ɗora fayiloli Ya fi tsayi, API maras fahimta sosai Haɗewar CI/CD Sauƙin haɗewa da GitHub Actions, Jenkins Ƙarfin haɗewa da kayan aikin CI da yawa Gwajin Wayar Hannu Iyakantacce, kwaikwayo kawai Cikakken goyon baya ta Appium Goyon Bayan Burauza Da Yawa Chromium, WebKit, Firefox Cikakken goyon baya a manyan burauza da tsofaffi Aiki Mai sauri, an inganta shi don gwajin headless Ya fi jinkiri, musamman a yanayin headless Gwajin Allo Da Yawa Iyakantacce Kyakkyawan goyon baya ga saitunan allo da yawa Al’umma Da Tsarin Muhalli Yana girma, kyawawan takardu Babba, balagagge, faffadan tsarin muhalli Shawara Bayan la’akari da buƙatu da musanyar, Playwright shi ne mafi kyawun zaɓi ga buƙatunmu na yanzu. API ɗinsa mai wayo don gwajin ɗora fayilolin gida, taƙaitaccen tsarin rubutunsa, da ƙarfin goyon bayansa ga gwajin UI mai mu’amala sun sa ya dace da zagayen ci gabanmu mai sassauci. Gaskiyar cewa yana goyon bayan TypeScript da Python duka yana da muhimmanci ga tawagarmu, kuma hanyar zamani ta tsarin ga gwaji za ta ba mu damar rubuta lamba mai tsabta, mai sauƙin kulawa. Ko da yake Selenium ya kasance kayan aiki mai kyau, musamman don gwajin wayar hannu, goyon bayan tsoffin burauza, da saitunan allo da yawa, bai dace sosai da buƙatunmu na yanzu ba. Tsawonsa, jinkirin aikinsa, da sarrafa UI masu motsi kamar zane-zane cikin sarƙaƙiya ya sa ya zama maras kyau ga amfaninmu. Sakamako Aiki Nan Take : Za mu karɓi Playwright don gwajin E2E ɗinmu, muna mai da hankali kan gwada hanyoyin masu amfani da suka haɗa da rajista, shiga, ɗora fayiloli, dashboards, da zazzage rahotanni. La’akari Na Dogon Lokaci : Za mu sa ido kan tsarin muhallin Playwright mai haɓaka. Idan buƙatunmu suka canza, musamman game da gwajin wayar hannu ko goyon bayan tsoffin burauza, za mu iya sake duba Selenium. Horo Da Takardu : Tawagogin ci gaba za su buƙaci saba da API ɗin Playwright, musamman don sarrafa UI masu motsi da ɗora fayiloli. Komawa : Za a mayar da gwaje-gwajen Selenium da ke akwai (idan akwai) zuwa Playwright a hankali. La’akari Na Gaba

records.title: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: tsarin SvelteKit
records.text: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: tsarin SvelteKit Kwanan wata: [Kwanan Wata na Yanzu] Matsayi: [an ba da shawara, an amince, an ƙi, an daina amfani] Mahalli Muna gina sabon aikace-aikacen yanar gizo wanda ke buƙatar gine-ginen gaba mai iya faɗaɗuwa da inganci. Bayan gudanar da cikakken nazarin tsarin aikin gaba daban-daban, mun zaɓi SvelteKit a matsayin tsarin da muka fi so. Shawara Mun yanke shawarar aiwatar da gine-ginen gaba na SvelteKit don aikace-aikacen yanar gizonmu. SvelteKit yana ba da ci-gaban tsarin haɓaka na gaba wanda yake da sauri, inganci, kuma mai sassauci. Ana iya amfani da shi don inganta manyan aikace-aikace da ƙanana. Dalili SvelteKit sabuwar mafita ce ta gaba mai cikakken tsari wacce ke ba da jerin siffofi kamar zana a sabar, sake lodi mai zafi, saitin da aka sauƙaƙa, da ƙari da yawa. Yana ba mu damar ƙirƙirar gine-ginen gaba masu inganci waɗanda za su iya sarrafa manyan aikace-aikace cikin sauƙi. Gine-ginen SvelteKit na tushen ɓangarori yana ba mu damar haɓaka ɓangarorin UI masu sake amfani da iya faɗaɗuwa waɗanda za a iya haɗa su cikin sauƙi tsakanin ayyuka daban-daban. Tsarin yana ba da kyakkyawan tallafi ga TypeScript, wanda ke ba mu damar rubuta lamba mai tsabta da tsari wacce take da sauƙin kulawa. Bugu da ƙari, SvelteKit yana ba da tsarin sarrafa takardu mai sauƙin amfani wanda ke ba mu damar bin diddigin duk shawarwarin gine-gine da canje-canjen aikinmu. Madadin da Aka Yi La’akari Mun kimanta wasu madadin, kamar React, Vue, Angular, da Next.js, amma da siffofinsa, sauƙin amfani, da ƙarfinsa, SvelteKit ya bayyana a fili a matsayin zaɓi ga aikinmu. Sakamako Aiwatar da gine-ginen gaba na SvelteKit zai ba da ingantacciyar ƙwarewar mai amfani, aiki, da sassauci. Za mu iya samun ingantaccen aiki ta hanyar saitunan tsarin da suka fi sauƙi, gine-ginen tushen ɓangarori, da kasancewar sassa. A sakamakon haka, aikinmu na iya zama mafi inganci da dorewa. Kammalawa Mun yanke shawarar aiwatar da gine-ginen gaba na SvelteKit don samun aikace-aikacen yanar gizo na zamani, mai iya faɗaɗuwa, kuma mai inganci tare da siffofi da kasancewar sassa da muke buƙata. Da kyakkyawan tallafinsa ga TypeScript, zana a sabar, da sauƙaƙa saitin, muna ganin cewa SvelteKit shi ne mafi kyawun zaɓi ga aikinmu. Yabo: ChatGPT ne ya samar da wannan shafi, sannan aka gyara shi don bayyanawa da tsari.

records.title: Tsarin tambarin lokaci
headings: Kayayyakin da aka samar masu alaƙa
records.text: Tsarin tambarin lokaci Abubuwan da ke ciki: Taƙaitawa Matsala Shawara Matsayi Cikakkun bayanai Zato Ƙuntatawa Ra’ayoyi Hujja Tasiri Mai alaƙa Shawarwari masu alaƙa Buƙatu masu alaƙa Kayayyakin da aka samar masu alaƙa Ƙa’idoji masu alaƙa Bayanan kula Taƙaitawa Matsala Muna son mu iya bin diddigin lokacin da abubuwa ke faruwa ta amfani da tambarin lokaci da kuma amfani da tsarin tambarin lokaci mai daidaito wanda ke aiki da kyau a duk tsarukanmu da tsarukan wasu kamfanoni. Muna mu’amala da tsarukan da ke da tsarin tambarin lokaci daban-daban: Saƙonnin JSON ba su da tsarin tambarin lokaci na asali, don haka muna buƙatar zaɓar yadda za a mayar da tambarin lokaci zuwa zare, da mayar da zare zuwa tambarin lokaci, wato yadda za a yi serialize/deserialize. Wasu aikace-aikace an saita su don amfani da lokacin gida, maimakon lokacin UTC. Wannan na iya zama da amfani ga ayyukan da dole ne su daidaita da lokacin gida, kamar ayyukan da ke tayar da abubuwan da suka faru bisa lokacin gida. Wasu tsarukan suna da buƙatu da iyawar daidaiton lokaci daban-daban, kamar amfani da ƙudurin lokaci na dakiku da milli-dakiku da nano-dakiku. Misali, umarnin date na tsarin aiki na Linux yana amfani da tsohon daidaiton lokaci na dakiku, yayin da kasuwar hannayen jari ta Nasdaq ke son tsohon daidaiton lokaci na nano-dakiku. Shawara Mun zaɓi ma’aunin tsarin tambarin lokaci ISO 8601 mai daidaiton nano-dakiku, musamman “YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.NNNNNNNNNZ”. Tsarin yana nuna shekara, wata, rana, awa, minti, daƙiƙa, nano-dakiku, da yankin lokaci na Zulu wato UTC, GMT. Matsayi An yanke shawara. Cikakkun bayanai Zato Muna buƙatar sarrafa waɗannan zaren rubutu na tambarin lokaci, don mayar da tambarin lokaci zuwa zare (wato serialize) da mayar da zare zuwa tambarin lokaci (wato deserialize). Muna son tsari wanda gabaɗaya yake da sauƙin amfani, sauƙin sauyawa, da sauƙin karantawa ga mutum. Muna son dacewa da faffadan tsarukan waje da ba za mu iya sarrafawa ba, kamar tsarukan nazari, tsarukan rumbun bayanai, tsarukan kuɗi. Ƙuntatawa Wasu tsarukan suna da iyakokin daidaiton lokaci. Misali, umarnin date na tsarin aiki na macOS na iya buga daidaiton lokaci a dakiku, amma ba a nano-dakiku ba. Ra’ayoyi Mun yi la’akari da jerin zaɓuɓɓuka: Unix epoch wato lamba ɗaya mai ƙaruwa. Tsarin rubutu a taƙaice “YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSNNNNNNNNN”. Amfani da yankin lokaci na gida da yankin lokaci na UTC. Hujja Don amfani na yau da kullum, muna daraja sauƙin karantawa/rubutu ga mutane fiye da gudun/girman tsantsa. Don amfani na yau da kullum, muna son tsari da ke aiki daidai a tsarukan inji, kuma yana aiki da kyau da hannu, kamar rubuta bayanan samfuri, karanta fitarwar JSON, grep a fayil log, da sauransu. Don amfani mara na yau da kullum, kamar lissafi mai babban aiki, muna sa ran za mu so inganta duk tsarin rubutu da muka zaɓa ta mayar da rubutun zuwa tsari mafi sauri, kamar nau’in abu na kwanan wata na ciki na harshen shirye-shirye. Don haka tsarin rubutu ba shi da muhimmanci sosai ga HPC. Tasiri Tsarukanmu daban-daban na rubutu da tsarukan lokaci za su haɗu a kan wannan tsari. Mai alaƙa Shawarwari masu alaƙa Wataƙila muna son hanya mai sauri/sauƙi ta bin diddigin bambancin lokaci wato tsawon lokaci. Waɗannan suna da sauƙi da tambarin lokaci na Unix epoch. Buƙatu masu alaƙa Wataƙila muna son daidaita shawararmu misali idan muna da buƙata mai alaƙa ta takamaiman nau’in tambarin saƙon log, kamar na Splunk, Sumo, ELK, da sauransu. Kayayyakin da aka samar masu alaƙa Masu tsara tsari da masu fassara na harshe: date-fns: Modern JavaScript date utility library Crono: date and time library for Rust Misalan Rosetta Code: System time Data format Show the epoch Misalan SixArm: now string Ƙa’idoji masu alaƙa Mai sauƙin sakewa. Za mu iya sauyawa cikin sauƙi zuwa wani tsari daban, kamar Unix epoch. Jinkirta ingantawa kafin lokaci. Don amfani na yau da kullum ba mu damu sosai da ƴan ƙarin haruffa ba kamar tsarin da ke amfani da dashes da colons. Bayanan kula Ƙara bayanan kula a nan.

records.title: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: zabar fasahar rumbun bayanai
headings: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: zabar fasahar rumbun bayanai
records.text: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: zabar fasahar rumbun bayanai Matsayi An karɓa Mahalli Muna ƙirar sabon aikace-aikace wanda ke buƙatar adanawa da dawo da bayanai ta hanya mai iya faɗaɗuwa da inganci. Mun gano nau’ikan fasahar rumbun bayanai guda uku da ake amfani da su sosai: rumbun bayanai na dangantaka, rumbun bayanai na takardu, da rumbun bayanai na abubuwan da suka faru. Rumbun bayanai na dangantaka suna adana bayanai a cikin teburori masu tsare-tsare ƙayyadaddu kuma suna tilasta ƙaƙƙarfan ƙuntatawar amincin bayanai. Sun dace da aikace-aikacen da ke buƙatar sarƙaƙiyar dangantakar bayanai da mu’amaloli. Misalai sun haɗa da MySQL, PostgreSQL, da Oracle. Rumbun bayanai na takardu suna adana bayanai a cikin takardu irin na JSON kuma ba su da tsari ƙayyadadde. Sun dace sosai da aikace-aikacen da ke buƙatar samfuran bayanai masu sassauci da faɗaɗawa a kwance. Misalai sun haɗa da MongoDB, Couchbase, da Amazon DynamoDB. Rumbun bayanai na abubuwan da suka faru suna adana bayanai a matsayin jerin abubuwan da suka faru, suna ɗaukar kowane canji ga bayanan. Sun dace da aikace-aikacen da ke buƙatar bincike, event sourcing, da sarƙaƙƙen sarrafa bayanai. Misalai sun haɗa da Apache Kafka, Apache Pulsar, da AWS Kinesis. Shawara Bayan kimanta buƙatu da ƙuntatawar aikace-aikacenmu a hankali, mun yanke shawarar amfani da rumbun bayanai na takardu. Dalili Mun zaɓi rumbun bayanai na takardu saboda: Aikace-aikacenmu yana buƙatar samfurin bayanai mai sassauci wanda zai iya canzawa a kan lokaci. Rumbun bayanai na takardu suna ba mu damar adana bayanai ba tare da tsari ƙayyadadde ba, wanda ke nufin za mu iya ƙara sababbin fagage ko canza tsarin takardun da ke akwai ba tare da gyara tsarin rumbun bayanai ba. Aikace-aikacenmu yana buƙatar faɗaɗawa a kwance don sarrafa manyan adadin bayanai da zirga-zirga. Rumbun bayanai na takardu suna da goyon baya na ciki ga sharding da kwaikwayo, wanda ke ba mu damar rarraba bayanai a sabar da yawa da sarrafa yawan karatu da rubutu. Aikace-aikacenmu yana buƙatar dawo da bayanai cikin sauri da inganci. Rumbun bayanai na takardu suna ba da ƙarfin ƙididdigewa da tambaya wanda ke ba mu damar dawo da bayanai cikin sauri da inganci. Aikace-aikacenmu ba ya buƙatar sarƙaƙƙen mu’amaloli ko dangantakar bayanai. Yayin da rumbun bayanai na dangantaka suka fi iya tilasta ƙuntatawar amincin bayanai da sarrafa sarƙaƙƙen mu’amaloli, aikace-aikacenmu ba shi da irin waɗannan buƙatu. Rumbun bayanai na takardu na iya ba da isasshen tabbacin daidaito da dorewa ga amfaninmu. Sakamako Ta hanyar zaɓar rumbun bayanai na takardu, za mu buƙaci saka hannun jari wajen koyo da fahimtar takamaiman fasahar da muka zaɓa. Bugu da ƙari, za mu buƙaci tabbatar da cewa samfurin bayanan aikace-aikacenmu ya dace sosai da samfurin bayanan rumbun bayanai na takardu don ƙara aiki da iya faɗaɗuwa. Duk da haka, mun yi imanin cewa fa’idodin amfani da rumbun bayanai na takardu sun fi kuɗin, kuma shi ne mafi dacewa ga buƙatu da ƙuntatawar aikace-aikacenmu.

records.title: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: zaɓuɓɓukan tantancewa da ba da izini
headings: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: zaɓuɓɓukan tantancewa da ba da izini
records.text: Rikodin shawarar gine-gine: zaɓuɓɓukan tantancewa da ba da izini Tantance aikace-aikacen yanar gizo (authentication) da ba da izini (authorization) ra’ayoyi ne guda biyu masu muhimmanci wajen tabbatar da samun damar aikace-aikace da ayyuka. Dukansu suna magana ne kan ainihin masu amfani da yadda ake ba da izini, amma suna mai da hankali kan fannoni daban-daban: Tantancewa shi ne tsarin tabbatar da ainihin mai amfani ko tsari. Ba da izini shi ne tsarin tantance waɗanne albarkatu ko ayyuka mai amfani ko tsarin da aka tantance zai iya samun dama. Yanzu, bari mu nutse cikin takamaiman ƙa’idodin sadarwa da fasahohin da kuka ambata, waɗanda ake amfani da su sosai a aikace-aikacen yanar gizo na zamani don sarrafa tantancewa da ba da izini. OAuth (Open Authorization) OAuth ma’auni ne na buɗe don ba da izini. Yana ba mai amfani damar ba aikace-aikacen wani kamfani iyakantaccen damar shiga albarkatunsa ba tare da raba bayanan shigarsa ba. Babban ra’ayin shi ne samun damar wakilci . Ana amfani da OAuth sau da yawa a yanayi da masu amfani za su iya shiga sabis na wani kamfani (misali, shiga da Google) ba tare da ba wannan kamfani sunan mai amfani da kalmar sirrinsu kai tsaye ba. Kwarara : OAuth yawanci yana bin kwarara ta tushen token , inda sabar ba da izini ke bayar da token na samun dama ga aikace-aikacen wani kamfani. Wannan token yana wakiltar izinin mai amfani, kuma aikace-aikacen yana amfani da shi don samun bayanan mai amfani ko albarkatunsa daga API. Misali : Mai amfani yana shiga aikace-aikacen wani kamfani da asusunsa na Google. Google yana tabbatar da ainihin mai amfani sannan ya ba da token wanda ke ba aikace-aikacen wani kamfani damar samun wasu bayanan Google (misali, Google Calendar). OAuth ba ya sarrafa tantancewa kai tsaye; yana game da ba da damar shiga ne. Don tantancewa, ana haɗa OAuth sau da yawa da wasu ƙa’idodin sadarwa, kamar OpenID Connect . OpenID Connect (OIDC) OpenID Connect (OIDC) yadin ainihi ne da aka gina a kan OAuth 2.0 wanda ke ƙara tantancewa ga iyawar ba da izini ta OAuth. A taƙaice, OpenID Connect yana faɗaɗa OAuth don sarrafa tantance mai amfani kuma yana ba da hanyar ma’auni ga aikace-aikace don tabbatar da ainihin mai amfani. Kwarara : Lokacin da mai amfani ke shiga ta amfani da OpenID Connect, aikace-aikacen wani kamfani yana neman token na ID (ban da token na samun dama na OAuth). Token na ID yana ɗauke da bayani game da mai amfani (kamar sunan mai amfani, imel, da sauran da’awa). Wannan yana ba aikace-aikacen damar sanin wanene mai amfani da ko an tantance shi. Misali : Shiga sabis kamar Slack ta amfani da asusun Google (Google shi ne mai samar da OpenID Connect) ya ƙunshi tantancewa ta OpenID Connect, yayin da OAuth ke sarrafa damar shiga albarkatun Google ɗinku. OIDC yana sauƙaƙa wa aikace-aikacen wasu kamfanoni tantance masu amfani yayin da yake ci gaba da ba da damar sarrafa dalla-dalla kan waɗanne albarkatu waɗannan aikace-aikacen za su iya samun dama. SAML (Security Assertion Markup Language) SAML tsoho ne, ma’auni na tushen XML da ake amfani da shi don musayar bayanan tantancewa da ba da izini tsakanin ɓangarori, musamman a yanayin Single Sign-On (SSO) . Ana amfani da shi galibi a muhallin kamfanoni don ba masu amfani damar tantancewa sau ɗaya su sami damar shiga aikace-aikace da yawa ba tare da sake shigar da bayanai ba. Kwarara : Mai amfani yana tantancewa da farko tare da mai samar da ainihi (IdP). IdP yana samar da SAML assertion mai sa hannu wanda ya haɗa da ainihin mai amfani da halayen da suka shafe shi. Ana aika assertion zuwa mai samar da sabis (SP), wanda ke amfani da shi don ba da izinin shiga aikace-aikacen. Misali : Ma’aikaci yana shiga tashar kamfaninsa (IdP) kuma ana shigar da shi ta atomatik cikin sauran tsarukan kamar imel, CRM, da sauransu, ba tare da sake shigar da bayanai ba. Tsarin tantancewa yana dogara ne kan assertion na SAML da IdP ya aika. Ana amfani da SAML sosai a mafitar SSO ta kamfanoni kuma yana aiki da kyau ga aikace-aikacen yanar gizo a muhallin kamfanoni, amma ba shi da sauƙin amfani a wayar hannu idan aka kwatanta da OAuth/OIDC. WS-Federation (Web Services Federation) WS-Federation wata ƙa’idar sadarwa ce da ake amfani da ita don Single Sign-On (SSO) , musamman a muhallin kamfanoni na tushen Microsoft. Yana cikin iyalin ƙayyadaddun bayanai na WS- (Web Services) kuma yana ba da damar haɗakar ainihi tsakanin yankunan tsaro daban-daban (kamar tsakanin ƙungiyoyi daban-daban ko tsakanin sabis daban-daban). Kwarara : WS-Federation yana ba mai samar da ainihi amintacce (IdP) damar tantance masu amfani da bayar da tokens waɗanda mai samar da sabis zai iya amfani da su don ba da izini. Yana kama da SAML amma ana amfani da shi sau da yawa a yanayin da ke dogara sosai kan fasahohin Microsoft. Misali : Mai amfani yana shiga aikace-aikacen kamfani da ake ɗauka a Microsoft Azure Active Directory (AD), kuma ana iya amfani da ainihinsa don samun damar shiga wasu sabis da aka haɗa, ciki har da aikace-aikacen da masu sayarwa na wasu kamfanoni ke ɗauka. Ko da yake sababbin ƙa’idodin sadarwa kamar OAuth2.0 da OpenID Connect sun maye gurbin WS-Federation a muhallin yanar gizo na zamani da yawa, har yanzu ana amfani da shi a tsoffin tsarukan, musamman a kamfanonin da suka mai da hankali kan Microsoft. LDAP (Lightweight Directory Access Protocol) LDAP ƙa’idar sadarwa ce da ake amfani da ita don samun dama da sarrafa sabis na kundin adireshi, wadda ake amfani da ita sosai don adana bayanan shigar masu amfani da sarrafa ikon shiga a kundin adireshi na tsakiya (wanda ake kira Sabis na Kundin Adireshi sau da yawa). LDAP ba musamman game da tantancewa ko ba da izini ba ne amma ana amfani da shi don adanawa da dawo da bayanan ainihi, waɗanda ake amfani da su a waɗannan tsare-tsare. Tantancewa : LDAP yana ba aikace-aikace damar tantance masu amfani ta hanyar tambayar sabis na kundin adireshi don bayanan shigarsu (kamar kalmomin sirri). Ba da izini : Yana kuma sarrafa matsayi da izinin masu amfani, yana taimakawa wajen tantance ko mai amfani yana da damar shiga wasu albarkatu. Misali : Kamfanoni da yawa suna amfani da kundin adireshi na tushen LDAP (misali, Active Directory ) don tantancewa da ba da izini, musamman a muhallin Windows. LDAP yana da muhimmanci ga kamfanoni wajen sarrafa damar masu amfani a tsarukan cikin gida, amma a yanayin yanar gizo na zamani, ana haɗa LDAP sau da yawa da wasu ƙa’idodin sadarwa kamar SAML ko OAuth don cikakken sarrafa ainihi. Masu Samar da Social SSO Masu samar da Single Sign-On (SSO) na zamantakewa kamar Facebook , Google , Twitter , GitHub , da sauransu suna ba masu amfani damar tantancewa a aikace-aikacen wasu kamfanoni ta amfani da bayanan shigar kafafen sada zumunta. Wannan wani nau’in tantancewa ne na tushen OAuth inda sabis na wani kamfani (misali, Google) shi ne mai samar da ainihi. Kwarara : Mai amfani yana danna “Shiga da Google” (misali). Aikace-aikacen yana tura zuwa Google, inda mai amfani ke shiga (idan bai riga ya shiga ba). Daga nan Google yana ba da token na samun dama ko token na ID ga aikace-aikacen wani kamfani, wanda za a iya amfani da shi don tantance mai amfani kuma wataƙila a sami bayanansa. Misali : Aikace-aikace da yawa suna ba ku damar shiga ta amfani da bayanan shigar Google ko Facebook. Aikace-aikacen zai yi amfani da OAuth ko OpenID Connect a bayan fage don tabbatar da ainihinku kuma, a wasu lokuta, ya sami damar shiga wasu bayanan kafafen sada zumunta. Social SSO hanya ce mai sauƙi kuma wadda aka karɓa sosai don tantancewa domin tana rage cikas ga masu amfani, waɗanda wataƙila ba sa son ƙirƙirar wani sunan mai amfani da kalmar sirri. --- Taƙaitaccen Bambance-bambance: OAuth : Ana amfani da shi don ba da izini, yana ba aikace-aikacen wasu kamfanoni damar samun bayanan mai amfani ba tare da bayyana bayanan shiga ba. OpenID Connect : Yana faɗaɗa OAuth don ba da tantancewa, yana ba aikace-aikace damar tabbatar da ainihin mai amfani. SAML : Ƙa’idar sadarwa ta tushen XML da ake amfani da ita don SSO, sau da yawa a muhallin kamfanoni. WS-Federation : Ƙa’idar sadarwa ta musamman ta Microsoft don haɗakar ainihi, ana amfani da ita a tsoffin tsarukan. LDAP : Ƙa’idar sadarwa don tambayar sabis na kundin adireshi don tantance masu amfani da sarrafa ba da izini. Masu Samar da Social SSO : Tsarukan tushen OAuth (kamar Google, Facebook) waɗanda ke ba aikace-aikacen wasu kamfanoni damar tantance masu amfani ta amfani da bayanan shigar kafafen sada zumuntarsu. Kowanne daga cikin waɗannan fasahohi yana da ƙarfinsa da yanayin amfaninsa, kuma a aikace-aikacen zamani, kuna iya ganin haɗin su ana amfani da shi don fannoni daban-daban na tsaro (misali, OAuth/OIDC don samun damar API, SAML don SSO na kamfanoni).

records.title: Samfurin rikodin shawara don lamarin kasuwanci
headings: Samfurin rikodin shawara don lamarin kasuwanci
records.text: Samfurin rikodin shawara don lamarin kasuwanci Wannan samfurin ADR yana jaddada ƙirƙirar lamarin kasuwanci don shawara, ciki har da ma’auni, ƴan takara, da kuɗaɗe. Matakin sama Take Matsayi Ma’aunin kimantawa Ƴan takarar da za a yi la’akari Bincike da nazari na kowane ɗan takara Ya cika/bai cika ma’auni ba da dalili Nazarin kuɗi Nazarin SWOT Ra’ayoyi da martani Shawara Zurfin bincike na matakin ƙasa Take : Gajeriyar jimla ta umarni a halin yanzu, ƙasa da haruffa 50, kamar saƙon commit na git. Matsayi : Ɗaya daga cikin an ba da shawara, an karɓa, an ƙi, an daina amfani, an maye gurbinsa, da sauransu. Ma’aunin kimantawa : Taƙaitawa: bayyana a taƙaice abin da muke neman ganowa da dalili. Cikakkun bayanai Ƴan takarar da za a yi la’akari : Taƙaitawa: bayyana a taƙaice yadda muka gano ƴan takara, kuma ku jawo hankali ga duk wani na musamman. Jera duk ƴan takara da zaɓuɓɓuka masu alaƙa; menene muke kimantawa a matsayin mafita masu yiwuwa? Cikakkun bayanai Bincike da nazari na kowane ɗan takara : Taƙaitawa: bayyana a taƙaice hanyoyin bincike, kuma ku jawo hankali ga tsari, gungu, da na musamman. Ya cika/bai cika ma’auni ba da dalili Taƙaitawa Cikakkun bayanai Nazarin kuɗi Taƙaitawa Misalai Lasisi, kamar yarjejeniyar kwangila da alƙawurran shari’a Horo, kamar haɓaka ƙwarewa da sarrafa canji Aiki, kamar tallafi da kulawa Aunawa, kamar bandwidth da amfani da CPU Nazarin SWOT Taƙaitawa Ƙarfi (Strengths) Rauni (Weaknesses) Dama (Opportunities) Barazana (Threats) Ra’ayoyin cikin gida da martani Taƙaitawa Misalai Daga tawaga, a manufa wanda ainihin mutum ya rubuta Daga sauran masu ruwa da tsaki Sifofin inganci wato buƙatun giciye-aiki Ra’ayoyin waje da martani Taƙaitawa Wa ke ba da ra’ayin? Waɗanne ƴan takara kuka yi la’akari? Me kuke ƙirƙira? Misalai B2B ko B2C mai fuskantar waje ko na ma’aikata kawai kwamfuta ko wayar hannu gwaji ko samarwa monolith ko microservices Yaya kuka kimanta ƴan takara? Me ya sa kuka zaɓi wanda ya yi nasara? Me ke faruwa tun daga lokacin? Misalai Yaya wanda ya yi nasara ke aiki? Kashi nawa cikin ɗari na zirga-zirgar masu amfani na zahiri a samarwa ke wucewa ta wanda ya yi nasara? Waɗanne irin haɗe-haɗe ne ke ciki, kamar da bututun isar da ci gaba, tsarin sarrafa abun ciki, nazari da ma’auni, da sauransu? Da abin da kuka sani yanzu, me za ku shawarci mutane su yi daban? Labaran kai Shawara : Taƙaitawa Cikakkun bayanai

records.title: Samfurin rikodin shawara don muhimman shawarwarin fasaha (ITD)
headings: Samfurin rikodin shawara don muhimman shawarwarin fasaha (ITD)
records.text: Samfurin rikodin shawara don muhimman shawarwarin fasaha (ITD) Wannan shi ne samfurin muhimman shawarwarin fasaha (ITD) da aka bayyana a ITDs: a lean ADR for executive technical decision-making at scale - Ignacio Larrañaga. ITD ci gaba ne mai mai da hankali na ADR, wanda aka inganta don sauri, bayyanawa, da tabbatar da shugabanci. Inda ADR ke rubuta abin da aka yanke, ITD kayan aiki ne mai sauƙi, mai fara da shawara, wanda ke sa shawarar kanta ta zama mai yiwuwa a bita, domin masu ruwa da tsaki su iya dubawa da sauri kuma su ƙalubalance ta cikin sauƙi. ITD sun dace da shawarwarin fasaha waɗanda ba lallai ne na gine-gine ba, kamar zaɓar samfuri, laburare, ko dabarar CI/CD. A cikin kowane fayil na ITD, rubuta waɗannan sassa: Take Bayyana shawarar kanta, ba bayanin batun ba. Misali, "Yi amfani da Qwen2.5 1.5B Instruct don fassara a cikin na’ura". Matsala Jumla ɗaya da ke bayyana abin da muke ƙoƙarin warwarewa. Zaɓuɓɓukan da aka yi la’akari Madadin da suka kasance a kan tebur, tare da zaɓin da aka zaɓa a cikin rubutu mai kauri . Dalili Abubuwan da suka yanke hukunci ne kawai waɗanda suka kai ga zaɓin, ba cikakken jerin kowane fa’ida da rashin fa’ida ba. Bayanan kula Na zaɓi. Duk wani ƙarin mahalli da ya cancanci a rubuta, kamar ƙuntatawa, zato, ko hanyoyin haɗi.
